Accepted seconds accumulate into quarter-second fixed ticks; paused state returns without stepping.
Landing follows the registered pad; horizontal distance<=6 descends directly to pad altitude at up to12m/accepted-second. Landing does not snap to parked before actual proximity.
Original native return waits60000 wall-clock milliseconds for actual parked status.
